newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW-Bank of Portugal cuts interest rates.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Bank of Portugal cuts interest rates.

text.p: The following are some analysts' reactions to the Bank of Portugal's cutting 20 basis points off its main interest rates on Monday.
RUI MARTINS DOS SANTOS, BANCO PORTUGUES DE INVESTIMENTO:

"It corresponds to the objective of the Bank of Portugal of a slow convergence with rates that will exist with the euro (single currency). There is room for cuts, and this will not be the last this year."
